C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, conversion, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number (or whole number) into an equivalent improper fraction with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a*c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n*d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Finding an LCM/common denominator without converting a mixed/whole number
Reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for two fractions
A step scales numerator and denominator to express fractions with the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Subtracting fractions that already share a denominator without any conversion
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing denominator alignment

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are in compatible form (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: Steps that only create equivalent fractions or find a common denominator
Steps that only simplify/reduce the final fraction without performing subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express the result in an acceptable final form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 → 7/4)
A step states the fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes an equivalent mixed form)
exclusion_criteria: Performing the subtraction itself without any reduction or final-form conversion
Finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers prior to subtraction

A.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting a mixed/whole number
Only subtracting fractions that already share a denominator

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) for two fractions with different denominators to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly computes an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step states a target common denominator before converting fractions
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and no common-denominator work is done
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Equivalent fraction scaling
skills.definition: Convert fractions to equivalent forms by multiplying numerator and denominator to reach a chosen common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a/b as (a·k)/(b·k) to match a common denominator
A step shows both fractions expressed over the same denominator after scaling
exclusion_criteria: Only selecting the common denominator (LCM) without performing the conversion
Only subtracting once denominators already match

skills.name: Subtract and simplify
skills.definition: Perform subtraction once denominators match (or by parts for mixed numbers) and express the result in simplest acceptable form (including reduction and whole-number results).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., x/d − y/d)
A step subtracts whole and fractional parts separately and recombines
A step reduces a fraction to lowest terms or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number/whole number
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed↔improper) without doing the subtraction
Only finding a common denominator without computing the difference

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, conversion, simplification)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine an appropriate common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Steps that compute an LCM or choose a shared denominator for unlike fractions
Steps that scale numerator/denominator to convert to equivalent fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Problems where denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing denominators between two fractions

skills.name: Convert mixed/whole numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers as equivalent improper fractions (or as fractions with a specified denominator) to enable fraction operations.
inclusion_criteria: Steps converting a mixed number to an improper fraction using (whole×denominator+numerator)/denominator
Steps rewriting an integer as a fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
exclusion_criteria: Reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation
Subtracting fractions that are already in compatible forms without any conversion

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers by subtracting numerators over a common denominator and/or combining whole and fractional parts correctly.
inclusion_criteria: Steps performing subtraction once forms are compatible (same denominator or already converted)
Steps subtracting whole parts and fractional parts and recombining the result
exclusion_criteria: Steps that only set up conversions (LCM/common denominator or mixed-to-improper) without executing subtraction
Steps that only simplify/reduce the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and express the final value in an acceptable form (integer, irreducible fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Steps reducing a fraction by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 reduced to 7/4)
Steps stating a fraction is already in lowest terms
Steps converting an improper fraction to a mixed number (or noting the equivalent mixed form)
exclusion_criteria: Finding a common denominator or converting inputs before subtraction
The subtraction computation itself without any reduction/formatting
